title: Mona Singh v. State of U.P. — bill correction treated as Clause 6.5
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Tarun Agarwala and Siddhartha Varma, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed; bill-correction application treated as Clause 6.5; EE to decide in 10 days.
headnote: A writ seeking correction of an electricity bill was disposed of by treating the petitioner's application as one under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and directing the Executive Engineer to decide it within ten days of production of a certified copy of the order.
facts: Smt. Mona Singh filed Writ-C No. 59222 of 2016 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and five others, seeking correction of her electricity bill. Counsel for the petitioner and for the respondents, including standing counsel and Chandan Agarwal, were heard. The Division Bench recorded only that she had applied for bill correction and disposed of the writ the same day without examining the charges on merits.

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking electricity bill correction is disposed of by treating the consumer's application as one under Clause 6.5, with a direction to the Executive Engineer to decide it within ten days of production of a certified copy of the order.

not_decided.point: Merits of the electricity bill correction
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the correctness of the bill; the Executive Engineer was left to decide the Clause 6.5 application.
